steps.description:
Write a function that takes in 1 positive integer and determine if it is divisible by 3. If it is, it will return True. Otherwise, it will return False.

Write a program that asks user to enter a positive integer and call your function. Display the returned result.

Follow the test output display format and comment your codes.

Hint: - The modulus operator % returns the remainder of a division. If a number is divisible by another, the remainder is zero.

Test Input 4

12

1

333

Test Output (Red Text - User Input) Test your program with the examples below:

Example 1 Input positive integer: 4 False

Example 2 Input positive integer: 12 True

Example 3 Input positive integer: 1 False

Example 4 Input positive integer: 333 True

Write a function that takes in 1 positive integer. It will check whether it is divisible by each number from 1 to the integer and display the result. For example, if 4 is entered, it will display: 4 is divisible by 1 4 is divisible by 2 4 is not divisible by 3 4 is divisible by 4

Write a program that asks user to enter a positive integer and call your function to perform the check.

Follow the test output display format and comment your codes.

Hint: - The modulus operator % returns the remainder of a division.

Test Input 4

8

Test Output (Red Text - User Input) Test your program with the examples below:

Example 1 Input positive integer: 4 4 is divisible by 1 4 is divisible by 2 4 is not divisible by 3 4 is divisible by 4

Example 2 Input positive integer: 8 8 is divisible by 1 8 is divisible by 2 8 is not divisible by 3 8 is divisible by 4 8 is not divisible by 5 8 is not divisible by 6 8 is not divisible by 7 8 is divisible by 8

A prime number is a number that can only be divided by 1 and itself, except for 1 (1 is not a prime number).

Write a function that takes in 1 positive integer and determine if it is a prime number. If it is, it will return "prime". Otherwise, it will return "not prime".

Write a program that asks user to enter a positive integer and call your function to check if it is a prime number. Display the returned result.

Follow the test output display format and comment on your codes.

Test Input 1

4

6

9

7

103

Test Output (Red Text - User Input) Test your program with the examples below:

Example 1 Input positive integer: 1 not prime

Example 2 Input positive integer: 4 not prime

Example 3 Input positive integer: 6 not prime

Example 4 Input positive integer: 9 not prime

Example 5

Input positive integer: 7 prime

Example 6 Input positive integer: 103 prime

Read the topic on "AI Paradigms in Coding" and "Upskilling with AI".
